positions.thesis: AMD received a Citi upgrade to Buy ($575 PT) on June 12 and announced a £2B UK AI infrastructure investment over five years, providing fresh stock-specific catalysts on top of broader AI server CPU demand. Semiconductor sector is recovering from the June 6 AVGO-guidance selloff; multiple Wall Street analysts have lifted AMD targets to $600-665. The Citi upgrade from Neutral represents institutional re-rating momentum.
